family: Body infographic / explanatory research graphic — Family B of SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md.
primary_job: Explain a mechanism, comparison, process, governance structure, boundary, sequence, or cross-section synthesis more efficiently than prose alone.

semantic_density.rationale: Medium-to-high semantic density is the deliberate target: retain comparison dimensions, causal steps, historical stages, and consequences that are load-bearing for the article's thesis (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §2). This is the field that mechanically distinguishes this artifact from visual/thumbnail, which is deliberately low.

visual_density.rationale: Compress visual chrome, not the argument: reduce boxes, fills, icons, borders, and repeated labels while preserving every load-bearing relationship (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §2, §4). Visual density is low even though semantic density is high — the two controls are independent (§2).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: Artifact-local text may include a separately authored visual title/subtitle, short stable semantic labels/module headings, axes/units/chronology, declared-and-verified values, short source attribution for independent circulation, and an optional restrained publisher signature. Parent article/section title used as publication chrome, publication date, content type/status/CTA, long citations/qualifiers, legal/editorially sensitive wording, and dense prose stay outside or in deterministic accessible layers (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §4.3; SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §10).

composition.dominant_structure: One primary question, answered by 2-4 strong semantic modules, one explicit reading path, and a consequence/tension/output when needed (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §4.2).
composition.reading_path: Single explicit path; a forking reading path is a split trigger (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6).
composition.negative_space: generous but subordinate to the comparison/mechanism structure
composition.chrome_level: low-to-medium; prefer typography and spacing hierarchy over cards, fills, and heavy borders (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §4)

audience_adaptation.domain-expert: Legend optional; may use denser domain encodings (e.g. custody/rights-chain vocabulary) without in-frame expansion.
audience_adaptation.domain-practitioner: Moderate label density with brief glossing on first use.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: Expand acronyms when necessary for comprehension and keep to the low end of the module range; move long explanations outside the raster.
audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Avoid this artifact class for a genuinely child-targeted piece unless the mechanism is essential; if used, cap at 2 modules, use plain-language labels only, avoid abstract encodings, and never make the legend load-bearing — simplifying the audience must never simplify the truth (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §9 constraint 1).

renderer_preference.rule: Exact labels, topology, arrows, evidence, comparison rows, chronology, and values remain deterministic, declared-and-verified, or otherwise auditable. That does not require the whole plate to be deterministic: integrated multimodal generation may own short structural text or bounded factual payload when the text-ownership contract permits it and post-render verification inspects the actual pixels/text. The deterministic lane remains the fallback for evidence that cannot tolerate variance.

gate.viewport: ~390px inline reading surface plus full-size/open/expand detail path when density requires it
requirements: visual topic/question identifiable at inline width
2-4 strong module boundaries readable after downscaling
dominant comparison/mechanism/reading direction clear without zoom
principal conclusion or tension clear when the visual carries one
fine labels/source attribution/secondary evidence may require larger view only when they are not the sole carrier of a load-bearing claim
load-bearing detail unreadable inline requires either a real detail-access path or plate split/redesign
no reliance on browser zoom as the intended default interaction

readability_gate.rationale: Mobile readability is progressive: first-read structure is a hard inline gate, while dense secondary detail may be inspected through an explicit larger-view path (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5; SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §10).

split_rule.rule: One plate, one primary question. Split when more than one primary question is being answered, the reading path forks repeatedly, more than 4 major modules compete for attention, the visual requires dashboard-like micro-panels, the primary semantic structure becomes legible only after expansion, or load-bearing detail is unreadable inline with no appropriate full-size/open/expand path. Secondary fine detail needing a larger view is not by itself a split trigger when first-read structure survives.

acceptance: passes VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md with a named new_information item beyond adjacent prose
answers exactly one primary question per plate
2-4 load-bearing modules with one explicit reading path
primary structure is understandable at ~390px inline without zoom
dense secondary detail has an appropriate full-size/open/expand path when needed
exact values, topology, or chronology remain deterministic/declared-and-verified/traceable
parent-publication copy remains outside the artwork
artifact-local title/subtitle/labels/source attribution/signature are allowed only when intrinsic, bounded, and verified
in-art source attribution supplements rather than replaces canonical page-level provenance
reject: mini dashboard or multi-panel report crammed into one plate
dense infographic collage or icon-per-cell composition
more than one primary question on a single plate
primary structure that only becomes legible after expansion
load-bearing detail unreadable inline with no explicit detail-access path
parent article title/date/status/CTA baked into the visual as publication chrome
source footer treated as a replacement for canonical provenance
minimalism achieved by deleting load-bearing dimensions, exceptions, or consequences (SUENGJ-INFOGRAPHIC-CALIBRATION.md §5)
